title: Demo app page: show the stats from /api/stats in the summary line
notes: Acceptance. The summary line #stats shows the count and the longest note length, for example '3 notes, longest 42 characters', read from GET /api/stats and refreshed after every add and delete; it says '0 notes' for an empty list. A Playwright test adds two notes of known length and checks the text. Tests first: unit tests in tests/notes/ and, for the page, a Playwright test in e2e/test_notes_app.py. Keep the selectors #t #f #n #v, a single <button> element and the brand colour #0b5fff. The existing browser tests and e2e/test_notes_live.py must keep passing. Do not touch .gitlab-ci.yml.
